title: Circuit embedding offset
statement: For a list $\mathcal D$ of directed acyclic circuits and a natural number $j$, define the offset recursively: it is $0$ for the empty list; for a nonempty list, it is the first circuit's number of gates when $j=0$, and otherwise it is that number plus one plus the offset at index $j-1$ in the remaining list.
